note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Exactly one supplied datum is substituted: the text on the filter tag (outcomes.maintained ↔ outcomes.suspended; finalState names the datum AFTER the substitution). The gate turns only after the new value settles; the previous datum stays traceable in the legend and a neutral Δ marker marks the changed tag. No suspension doctrine, dates or time limits; nothing is judged.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The datum changes from effect maintained to effect suspended according to the data supplied; the gate closes and the chevrons past it go grey.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the opposite substitution — from effect suspended to effect maintained: the gate starts closed (pause glyph, grey chevrons) and turns open, the chevrons past it light up; other fictional texts.
